key: Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important.
s: After the spider parable, the Prophet is told to recite the revelation and keep up the prayer; al-Tabari, on 29:44 to 29:45, takes the ‘remembrance of Allah’ as God’s remembrance of His servants, greater than theirs of Him, judging this nearest the plain text.

evidence.words: اختلف أهل التأويل في تأويله، فقال بعضهم: معناه: ولذكر الله إياكم أفضل من ذكركم. … قال أبو جعفر: وأشبه هذه الأقوال بما دلّ عليه ظاهر التنزيل، قول من قال: ولذكر الله إياكم أفضل من ذكركم إياه.
evidence.gloss: The people of interpretation differed on its interpretation; some said its meaning is: God’s remembrance of you is better than your remembrance. … Abu Ja‘far said: the view most consonant with what the plain text of the revelation indicates is that of whoever said: God’s remembrance of you is better than your remembrance of Him.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, Al-’Ankabut 29:45, at 3384; the key begins at a sentence start inside the ayah). Opened the packet for 29:45 (all sources); al-Tabari comments on 29:44 to 29:45 as one segment. He lists four views of the remembrance clause (God’s remembrance of you; your remembrance of God above all; God’s remembrance of the servant in prayer; the prayer and remembrance in it greater than what it forbids) and then, as Abu Ja‘far, states his own preference: God’s remembrance of you is better than your remembrance of Him, as nearest the plain text. The sentence reports that preference, which he states himself (roster trap satisfied). ‘Greater’ renders his reading of akbar; he glosses with afdal (better), no drift in substance. Plain sense faithful: the spider parable at 29:41, the command to recite and keep up worship in the same ayah addressed to the Prophet. entry-check ok, no changes.
